title: INTERVAL — MONTH_12 table
description: Array of donor records. One element is one donor at the 12-month follow-up questionnaire. A blank in the provider's data is written as an empty string; the dictionary's own codes are kept as constants.
$comment: Category files are wired into allOf as each category is converted. JSON Schema cannot enforce uniqueness of rows: the dictionary lists no participant identifier (D010/D011).
